verdict.rationale: Puzzle has a documented public REST API: a ReadMe-hosted reference with per-endpoint Try It consoles, an unauthenticated OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec at /rest/v0, and a separate sandbox server. However, access is request-gated by email rather than self-serve, the API is v0 and 'currently under development', and it was built for platform-to-platform embedded integrations rather than individual users driving their own account. missing for 10: self-serve API key provisioning for end users, a discoverable linked spec, evidence of full product coverage beyond embedded-accounting endpoints, a changelog or deprecation policy, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Puzzle publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document (info title "Puzzle Api", server https://app.puzzle.io/rest/v0) on its app domain
The ReadMe-hosted API reference ships the live "Try It!" console per endpoint
Request your sandbox credentials by emailing us at
Our API is currently under development. We will be continually adding new features and endpoints
Our API was originally architected for deep platform-to-platform integrations.
